title: DashboardRenderer keeps the header wrapper as a full blank grid row when the console chrome suppresses its content
body:
DashboardRenderer keeps the header wrapper as a full blank grid row when the console chrome suppresses its content Measured on `@objectstack/console` 17.1.0 (`plugin-dashboard-*.js`), HotCRM's `executive_dashboard`, viewed inside the console at `/_console/apps//dashboard/`. ## Symptom Between the console page header (title + description) and the dashboard's filter bar sits a blank band ~189 CSS px tall. Measured DOM in that band: ```html
``` One empty div, spanning the full grid width, occupying an entire grid row (the dashboard grid's row sizing gives it 64px) plus `mb-4`. On a 900px-tall viewport this pushes the KPI row halfway down the first screen; the user reads it as "the dashboard forgot to load something". ## Cause, from the shipped bundle The renderer builds the header wrapper on `e.header` alone, then gates each **child** on the embedded flag: ```js de = e.header && jsxs(`div`, { className: `col-span-full mb-4`, children: [ !f && e.header.showTitle !== !1 && q && jsx(`h2`, …), // suppressed when f (console chrome present) !f && e.header.showDescription !== !1 && e.description && …, // suppressed when f e.header.actions && e.header.actions.length > 0 && … // absent on this dashboard ]}) ``` When the console renders its own page chrome (`f` truthy), the title and description children evaluate to `false` — correctly, they would duplicate the chrome — but the **wrapper div renders regardless**, and an empty child in the dashboard grid still claims a full row. ## Impact Any dashboard that declares `header:` (with no `actions`) shows the blank row when viewed inside the console. HotCRM declares `header: { showTitle: true, showDescription: true }` on **all five** of its dashboards, so every dashboard page in the flagship exemplar opens with a dead band above the filters. The app author has no lever: authoring `header` is correct (it is what renders in a standalone embed), and removing it to dodge the blank would trade a platform bug for lost standalone behaviour. ## Expected Collapse the wrapper when every child is suppressed — compute the children first and render the `div` only if any survive (or gate the wrapper on `!f || actions.length`). The `header` declaration should cost zero pixels when the chrome already owns the title. Found while walking HotCRM's dashboards with the maintainer; back-link: filed from the hotcrm seat during the #1209 follow-up round.
